source.note: Every value recorded here was read out of assets/css/site.css as shipped. Light is the default ground; dark values carry the -dark suffix.

ground.purpose: Default ground plane; also the text colour that sits on ink.

ground-sunken.purpose: The single sunken plane, used only on .band--sunken.

ground-elev.purpose: The raised plane: the deliverable frame and form inputs, nothing else.

ink.purpose: Headings, marks, stage names, input text, the submit fill.

ink-body.purpose: Body copy, nav links at rest, deliverable descriptions.

ink-mute.purpose: Every monospace readout, record titles, notes and hints.

rule.purpose: The diagram: band tops, row rules, frame borders, the unlit rail.

rule-strong.purpose: Lines that indicate rather than divide: link rules, field borders, unlit lamp rings.

live.purpose: Focus ring, caret, selection, hovered links and rules, focused field border, submit hover, success status.

live-dot.purpose: Lamp fill and ring at the instant the mimic sweep reaches it.

danger.purpose: Field errors, invalid field borders, error-toned form status. Contact form only.

live-dark.purpose: Dark-theme signal green; text and lamp collapse to one value.

live-dot-dark.purpose: Declared separately but identical to live-dark (#3FC47E).

display.purpose: The single hero sentence. Balanced, capped at 54% of the bleed above 940px.

headline.purpose: Every section head. Balanced, capped at 20ch (26ch in the wide band).

wordmark.purpose: The lowercase 'systim' mark in the masthead; the footmark is the same at 1.0625rem.

body.purpose: Document default; also the input face at 1rem/1.5.

prose.purpose: Paragraphs inside .prose, held to 62ch with 1.15em between paragraphs.

label.purpose: Integration panel keys and form field labels. Chivo Mono, uppercase.

readout.purpose: Record state lines, mimic reference marks, the deliverable frame label.

meta.purpose: Footer meta lines and record field names.

extensions.shadowPolicy: None. The stylesheet contains zero box-shadow, text-shadow and drop-shadow declarations. Depth is three tonal ground planes plus a two-weight 1px hairline vocabulary. The single translucent layer is the masthead: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ground) 86%, transparent) with backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(14px), and a solid --ground fallback under @supports not (backdrop-filter: blur(1px)).

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The only easing curve in the system (--ease). Every colour and border transition uses it.

motion.name: dur
motion.purpose: The only transition duration (--dur): link/nav/field/button colour and border changes, and the body's theme cross-fade.

motion.name: dur-skip
motion.purpose: The skip link's transform reveal — the one duration that is not --dur.

motion.name: mimic-cycle
motion.purpose: The mimic relay's cycle (--cycle). Both the rail sweep and every lamp run on it, linear and infinite.

motion.name: mimic-sweep
motion.purpose: The green sweep riding the rail. Its centre crosses one fifth of the rail every 1.22s.

motion.name: mimic-sweep-y
motion.purpose: The vertical form of the sweep below 740px.

motion.name: mimic-lamp-delays
motion.purpose: Per-lamp animation-delay, spaced exactly 1.22s so each lamp fires as the sweep centre reaches its dot.

motion.name: mimic-lamp-keyframes
motion.value: 0% rest (ground fill / rule-strong ring / scale(1)); 2% lit (live-dot fill and ring / scale(1.3)); 9% hold; 22%-100% rest
motion.purpose: The lamp is lit for ~7% of the cycle (~0.49s) and dark for the rest.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation-duration: 0.001ms; iteration-count: 1; transition-duration: 0.001ms; rail repainted flat in --rule; lamps pinned at rest with transform: none
motion.purpose: The sweep halts entirely and the rail reads as a static diagram.

breakpoints.name: nav-tight
breakpoints.purpose: Nav gap and font size tighten rather than clipping.

breakpoints.name: rail-vertical
breakpoints.purpose: The mimic rail rotates to a vertical column at the left.

breakpoints.name: masthead-inline
breakpoints.purpose: Masthead becomes sticky, nav moves inline, panel rows split two-column, touch sizing ends.

breakpoints.name: records-three
breakpoints.purpose: The records grid becomes three columns.

breakpoints.name: band-split
breakpoints.purpose: Band grids and engagement stages become multi-column.

breakpoints.name: hero-cap
breakpoints.purpose: The hero line is capped at 54% of the bleed; the contact split opens.

layout.name: band-arrangement-default
layout.purpose: Head-left / prose-right. The objection and handover bands.

layout.name: band-arrangement-head
layout.purpose: Full-width head over a ruled list. The engagement stages.

layout.name: band-arrangement-stack
layout.purpose: Head over lead in one narrow column. The integration-surface band.

layout.name: band-arrangement-wide
layout.value: minmax(0,1fr) @900px, head max 26ch, lead justify-self:end max 48ch, gap clamp(20px, 2.4vw, 34px)
layout.purpose: Head at full measure, lead settled right. The selected-work band.

layout.name: block-lead
layout.purpose: The repeated step between a band's head block and its instrument block (mimic, panel, records, deliverable).

theming.flashPrevention: A blocking script in <head> reads localStorage['systim-theme'] and stamps data-theme on <html> before first paint, inside try/catch so private mode falls through to the media query.
theming.toggle: Ships hidden in markup and is revealed by site.js, so a no-JS visitor is never handed a dead control. aria-pressed and aria-label are repainted on every change.
theming.transition: body transitions background-color and color over 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1).

browserSurfaces.name: caret
browserSurfaces.value: caret-color: var(--live) on inputs and textareas

browserSurfaces.name: scrollbar
browserSurfaces.value: scrollbar-color: var(--rule-strong) transparent; scrollbar-width: thin; ::-webkit-scrollbar 11px; thumb var(--rule-strong) with 3px var(--ground) border and 99px radius, var(--ink-mute) on hover; track transparent

browserSurfaces.name: focus-ring
browserSurfaces.value: 2px solid var(--live), outline-offset 3px, border-radius 2px; :focus:not(:focus-visible) clears it; inputs tighten outline-offset to 1px on focus

browserSurfaces.name: numerals
browserSurfaces.value: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on mimic refs, stage refs, record values and the footer year

loadBearing: --rule and --rule-strong (the two-weight hairline vocabulary that replaces shadow entirely)
--live and --live-dot (the one signal, gated to live state)
--sans and --mono with the driven wdth axis (94 / 96 / 92 / 100)
--cycle 7s and the five lamp delays 0.45 / 1.67 / 2.89 / 4.11 / 5.33s (the signature interaction's timing)
--gutter, --bleed-max and --band-y (the page's one container and its rhythm)
The four band arrangements: default, head, stack, wide
incidental: --danger (used in three places, all inside the contact form)
--ease and --dur (one curve, one duration; a single value each rather than a scale)
the 99px scrollbar-thumb radius (browser furniture, not page geometry)
the 180ms skip-link transform, the one duration outside --dur

components.name: Submit Button
components.description: The system's only filled button. Graphite at rest, signal green on hover.

components.name: Ruled Link
components.description: The panel's one link vocabulary. A 1px strong-hairline rule under graphite text; both turn signal green on hover.

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Monospace uppercase label over a lit-plane field with a strong hairline border; the border and caret both report in signal green.
components.html: Roughly what it is, who runs it today, and how often.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; } .ds-field label { font: 500 0.75rem/1 var(--mono, 'Chivo Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace); letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-mute, #6B6859); } .ds-field input { width: 100%; padding: 13px 14px; background: var(--ground-elev, #FBFAF7); border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #A29D92); border-radius: 3px; color: var(--ink, #16150F); caret-color: var(--live, #17724A); font: 400 1rem/1.5 var(--sans, 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); transition: border-color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), background-color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-mute, #6B6859); } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: var(--live, #17724A); outline: 2px solid var(--live, #17724A); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-field-hint { margin: 0; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--ink-mute, #6B6859); font-family: var(--sans, 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-field[data-invalid] input { border-color: var(--danger, #A3341F); }

components.name: Mimic Relay
components.description: The signature interaction. An 18%-wide signal-green sweep rides a 1px hairline rail from -20% to 120% over a 7s linear cycle; five lamps fire at 0.45/1.67/2.89/4.11/5.33s, exactly 1.22s apart, as the sweep centre reaches each dot. The page's only self-starting motion; it halts entirely under reduced motion.
components.html:
1. 1Map
  2. 2Build
  3. 3Integrate
  4. 4Prove
  5. 5Hand over
components.css: .ds-mimic { --dot: 11px; --rail-y: 30px; --cycle: 7s; position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr)); margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; font-family: var(--sans, 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-mimic::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: calc(var(--rail-y) + (var(--dot) - 1px) / 2); height: 1px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, var(--live, #17724A) 50%, transparent 100%), linear-gradient(var(--rule, #C9C5BC), var(--rule, #C9C5BC)); background-size: 18% 100%, 100% 100%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-position: -20% 0, 0 0; animation: ds-mimic-sweep var(--cycle) linear infinite; } @keyframes ds-mimic-sweep { to { background-position: 120% 0, 0 0; } } .ds-mimic-stage { position: relative; padding-right: 16px; padding-top: var(--rail-y); } .ds-mimic-ref { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; font: 500 0.6875rem/1 var(--mono, 'Chivo Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--ink-mute, #6B6859); } .ds-mimic-dot { display: block; width: var(--dot); height: var(--dot); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ground, #F4F2EE); border: 1.5px solid var(--rule-strong, #A29D92); position: relative; z-index: 1; animation: ds-mimic-lamp var(--cycle) linear infinite; } .ds-mimic-stage:nth-child(1) .ds-mimic-dot { animation-delay: 0.45s; } .ds-mimic-stage:nth-child(2) .ds-mimic-dot { animation-delay: 1.67s; } .ds-mimic-stage:nth-child(3) .ds-mimic-dot { animation-delay: 2.89s; } .ds-mimic-stage:nth-child(4) .ds-mimic-dot { animation-delay: 4.11s; } .ds-mimic-stage:nth-child(5) .ds-mimic-dot { animation-delay: 5.33s; } @keyframes ds-mimic-lamp { 0% { background: var(--ground, #F4F2EE); border-color: var(--rule-strong, #A29D92); transform: scale(1); } 2% { background: var(--live-dot, #1B8A57); border-color: var(--live-dot, #1B8A57); transform: scale(1.3); } 9% { background: var(--live-dot, #1B8A57); border-color: var(--live-dot, #1B8A57); transform: scale(1.3); } 22%, 100% { background: var(--ground, #F4F2EE); border-color: var(--rule-strong, #A29D92); transform: scale(1); } } .ds-mimic-label { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; margin-top: 8px; font-size: clamp(0.9375rem, 1.35vw, 1.1875rem); font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--ink, #16150F); text-decoration: none; transition: color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-mimic-label:hover { color: var(--live, #17724A); } .ds-mimic-label:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--live, #17724A); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-mimic::before { background-image: linear-gradient(var(--rule, #C9C5BC), var(--rule, #C9C5BC)); background-size: 100% 100%; background-position: 0 0; animation: none; } .ds-mimic-dot { animation: none; background: var(--ground, #F4F2EE); border-color: var(--rule-strong, #A29D92); transform: none; } }

components.description: A hairline-ruled key/value row: a monospace uppercase key at 11rem, and graphite values wrapping in a flex list.
components.css: .ds-panel { margin: 0; font-family: var(--sans, 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-panel-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 11rem) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: clamp(24px, 4vw, 64px); align-items: baseline; padding-block: clamp(20px, 2.2vw, 28px); border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #C9C5BC); } .ds-panel-row:last-child { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #C9C5BC); } .ds-panel-key { font: 500 0.75rem/1.6 var(--mono, 'Chivo Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace); letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-mute, #6B6859); } .ds-panel-val { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 22px; margin: 0; } .ds-panel-val span { font-size: clamp(0.9375rem, 1.2vw, 1.0625rem); color: var(--ink, #16150F); letter-spacing: -0.012em; } @media (max-width: 759px) { .ds-panel-row { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 10px; } }

narrative.overview:
This is a process-control mimic panel rendered as a webpage. Every structural line on the page is a 1px hairline the colour of a printed schematic rule; every numeral, key and state readout is set in monospace because it is a measurement, not a decoration; and a single signal green appears only where a system is reporting live. The page reads like the wall of a plant control room at rest: warm, flat, precisely ruled, and mostly empty — with one lamp line that keeps running whether or not anyone is watching.

The palette is warm, not clinical. The ground is a paper-white with a yellow cast (#F4F2EE), not a screen white; the ink is a warm graphite (#16150F), not black. Depth is achieved entirely by three tonal ground planes and a hairline vocabulary. Density is low at the top of the page and rises as the visitor descends: the hero holds one sentence across roughly half the bleed and leaves the rest empty, while the engagement stages, integration panel and handover frame compress into tight ruled rows. That gradient — spacious to instrumented — is the page's argument, and it should be preserved on any second surface.

What this world refuses is as load-bearing as what it uses. There is no box-shadow anywhere in the stylesheet; there are no filled buttons other than the single submit control; there are no icons other than the theme toggle's own sun/moon glyph; there is no decorative colour. Green never appears as branding, only as state. Both themes are first-class: light is the declared default ground because the buyer reads on a desktop mid-workday, and dark is offered rather than assumed.
keyCharacteristics: Three ground planes only — sunken, default, elevated — and no fourth
Elevation declared once, as a 1px hairline; zero box-shadow in the entire stylesheet
Archivo with its wdth axis actually driven (94 / 96 / 92) for voice; Chivo Mono strictly for measurement
One signal green, permitted only where a system reports live
One self-starting motion moment on the page — the mimic sweep — and nothing else
Browser chrome (selection, caret, scrollbar, focus ring) themed from the same palette

rules.name: The Live-Only Rule
rules.body: Green is a report, not a brand colour. It is permitted only where something is genuinely reporting live: a lamp the sweep has just reached, a control the visitor is currently focused on or hovering, a caret in a field they are typing into, a status that actually succeeded. It never fills a heading, a divider, a background, or a resting button.

rules.name: The Two-Hairline Rule
rules.body: rule divides; rule-strong indicates. A line that only separates two blocks of content is rule. A line that says "this is a link" or "this is a field" or "this lamp is off" is rule-strong. Do not introduce a third hairline weight or colour.

rules.name: The Unlit Lamp Rule
rules.body: A lamp with no data behind it is a hollow ring in rule-strong, never a grey fill and never a green one. The three record lamps are unlit on purpose because those channels are awaiting real client data; lighting them would be the page claiming proof it does not have.

rules.name: The Measurement-Only Rule
rules.body: Chivo Mono is permitted for numerals, reference marks, keys, state labels, field names, and the footer meta line. It is never used for a heading, a sentence, a button, a link in running text, or anything chosen for texture. If it is not being read as a value, it is Archivo.

rules.name: The Driven-Width Rule
rules.body: Display type narrows. The wdth axis is a structural part of the voice, not a nicety: 94 on the hero line, 96 on section heads, 92 on the wordmark and footmark, 100 on everything else. A new heading that ships at default width will look foreign even at the correct size and weight.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Text is always capped: 62ch for prose, 58ch for the hero lead and stage bodies, 54ch for deliverable descriptions, 48ch for the lead in a wide band, 26ch or 20ch for heads. Nothing on this page runs the full bleed as text.

rules.name: The Hairline-Not-Gap Rule
rules.body: Sections are separated by a 1px rule border, not by extra whitespace or a coloured band. The only tonal band break in the system is the single sunken plane.

rules.name: The Empty-Right Rule
rules.body: The hero sentence stops at 54% of the bleed above 940px. The remaining space is not available for a graphic, a form, a stat block or a screenshot. The emptiness is the claim.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Zero box-shadow in the stylesheet. If something must separate from its surroundings, it gets a 1px hairline or a tonal plane change. A shadow anywhere on a future surface breaks the world, not just the page.

rules.name: The Three-Plane Rule
rules.body: Sunken, default, elevated. Exactly three. Sunken is for a band that recedes; elevated is for a surface you reach into. Do not add a fourth tone to signal a fourth level of importance.

rules.name: The Square-Container Rule
rules.body: Containers are square. Radius is reserved for controls (3px) and lamps (50%). A rounded card in this world reads as borrowed from a different one.

dos: Do declare elevation with a 1px hairline or a tonal plane change. rule divides, rule-strong indicates.
Do drive Archivo's width axis on display type — 94 on a hero line, 96 on a section head, 92 on a mark. Default width reads as a foreign typeface here.
Do reserve Chivo Mono for numerals, keys, reference marks, state labels and field names — things being read as values.
Do cap every text block: 62ch prose, 58ch leads and stage bodies, 54ch deliverable descriptions, 48ch wide-band leads, 20–26ch heads.
Do choose one of the four established band arrangements when adding a section rather than inventing a fifth.
Do use the repeated clamp(44px, 5vw, 76px) step between a band's head block and its instrument block.
Do theme browser surfaces from the palette — selection, caret, scrollbar, focus ring — on any new surface.
Do keep every new colour value in both themes; the dark form is not an afterthought.
Do halt any motion entirely under prefers-reduced-motion and render the affected element in its resting state, as the mimic rail does.
Do grow standalone controls to 44px below 760px or on a coarse pointer.
donts: Don't add a box-shadow anywhere. The stylesheet has zero, and that is the rule.
Don't add a fourth ground plane. Sunken, default, elevated — three.
Don't use green as decoration, branding, a fill, or a heading colour. It reports live state only.
Don't light a lamp for a channel that has no data. Unlit is a hollow rule-strong ring, and it is honest.
Don't add a second self-starting animation. The mimic sweep is the page's only unbidden motion; everything else responds to the visitor.
Don't round a container. Radius belongs to controls (3px) and lamps (50%).
Don't introduce a second filled button. Secondary actions are ruled links.
Don't set body copy, headings, buttons or in-sentence links in Chivo Mono.
Don't fill the empty right side of the hero. The stop at 54% is the composition.
Don't add a gradient. The only one in the system is the mimic sweep itself, and it is a moving light, not a surface.
